tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Image typed files can be dynamically resized and transformed to fit any need.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: All data within the platform is private by default. The public role can be configured to expose data without authentication, or you can pass an access token to the API to access private data.

tags.name: Schema
tags.description: Retrieve and update the schema of an instance.

tags.name: Server
tags.description: Access to where Directus runs. Allows you to make sure your server has everything needed to run the platform, and check what kind of latency we're dealing with.

tags.name: Utilities
tags.description: Directus comes with various utility endpoints you can use to simplify your development flow.

tags.name: ItemsCeremonies
tags.description: Nuptial Mass ceremony details — singleton

tags.name: Activity
tags.description: All events that happen within Directus are tracked and stored in the activities collection. This gives you full accountability over everything that happens.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Roles are groups of users that share permissions.

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: Collections are the individual collections of items, similar to tables in a database. Changes to collections will alter the schema of the database.

tags.name: Folders
tags.description: Group files by virtual folders.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Files can be saved in any given location. Directus has a powerful assets endpoint that can be used to generate thumbnails for images on the fly.

tags.name: Relations
tags.description: What data is linked to what other data. Allows you to assign authors to articles, products to sales, and whatever other structures you can think of.

tags.name: Permissions
tags.description: Permissions control who has access to what and when.

tags.name: Revisions
tags.description: Revisions are individual changes to items made. Directus keeps track of changes made, so you're able to revert to a previous state at will.

tags.name: ItemsPersons
tags.description: Universal contact hub — all people in the system resolve here

tags.name: Presets
tags.description: Presets hold the preferences of individual users of the platform. This allows Directus to show and maintain custom item listings for users of the app.

tags.name: Flows
tags.description: Flows enable custom, event-driven data processing and task automation.

tags.name: Operations
tags.description: Operations are the building blocks within Data Flows.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Users are what gives you access to the data.

tags.name: Versions
tags.description: Enables users to create unpublished copies of an item, modify them independently from the main version, and promote them to become the new main version when ready.

tags.name: Fields
tags.description: Fields are individual pieces of content within an item. They are mapped to columns in the database.

tags.name: Extensions
tags.description: Directus can easily be extended through the addition of several types of extensions, including layouts, interfaces, and modules.

storage.description: Where the file is stored. Either `local` for the local filesystem or the name of the storage adapter (for example `s3`).

filename_disk.description: Name of the file on disk. By default, Directus uses a random hash for the filename.

filename_download.description: How you want to the file to be named when it's being downloaded.

title.description: Title for the file. Is extracted from the filename on upload, but can be edited by the user.

folder.description: Virtual folder where this file resides in.

filesize.description: Size of the file in bytes.

width.description: Width of the file in pixels. Only applies to images.

height.description: Height of the file in pixels. Only applies to images.

duration.description: Duration of the file in seconds. Only applies to audio and video.

embed.description: Where the file was embedded from.

location.description: Where the file was created. Is automatically populated based on Exif data for images.

tags.description: Tags for the file. Is automatically populated based on Exif data for images.

metadata.description: IPTC, Exif, and ICC metadata extracted from file

uploaded_on.description: When the file was last uploaded/replaced.

parent.description: Unique identifier of the parent folder. This allows for nested folders.

description.example: Admins have access to all managed data within the system by default

email.description: Unique email address for the user.

tags.description: The user's tags.

language.description: The user's language used in Directus.

tfa_secret.description: The 2FA secret string that's used to generate one time passwords.

role.description: Unique identifier of the role of this user.

last_access.description: When this user used the API last.

last_page.description: Last page that the user was on.

fields.description: Control what fields are being returned in the object.

search.description: Filter by items that contain the given search query in one of their fields.

sort.description: How to sort the returned items.

limit.description: Set the maximum number of items that will be returned

offset.description: How many items to skip when fetching data.

page.description: Cursor for use in pagination. Often used in combination with limit.

deep.description: Deep allows you to set any of the other query parameters on a nested relational dataset.

total_count.description: Returns the total item count of the collection you're querying.

filter_count.description: Returns the item count of the collection you're querying, taking the current filter/search parameters into account.

rsvp_token.description: Auto-generated token from creating this data

invitation_label.description: Label of the role based on the type of invitation

user.description: The user who performed this action.

ip.description: The IP address of the user at the time the action took place.

user_agent.description: User agent string of the browser the user used when the action took place.
user_agent.example: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_1) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML,like Gecko) Chrome/78.0.3904.108 Safari/537.36

collection.description: Collection identifier in which the item resides.

item.description: Unique identifier for the item the action applied to. This is always a string, even for integer primary keys.

origin.description: Origin of the request when the action took place.

collection.description: The collection key.

many_collection.description: Collection that has the field that holds the foreign key.

many_field.description: Foreign key. Field that holds the primary key of the related collection.

one_collection.description: Collection on the _one_ side of the relationship.

one_field.description: Alias column that serves as the _one_ side of the relationship.

junction_field.description: Field on the junction table that holds the many field of the related relation.

collection.description: What collection this permission applies to.

action.description: What action this permission applies to.

permissions.description: JSON structure containing the permissions checks for this permission.

validation.description: JSON structure containing the validation checks for this permission.

presets.description: JSON structure containing the preset value for created/updated items.

fields.description: CSV of fields that the user is allowed to interact with.

activity.description: Unique identifier for the activity record.

collection.description: Collection of the updated item.

data.description: Copy of item state at time of update.

delta.description: Changes between the previous and the current revision.

parent.description: If the current item was updated relationally, this is the id of the parent revision record

preferred_name.description: Goes by this name — use in printed materials

notes.description: Internal only — not read aloud or printed

gender.description: Required — used for processional pairing and printed materials

id.description: Unique identifier for this single collection preset.

bookmark.description: Name for the bookmark. If this is set, the preset will be considered a bookmark.

user.description: The unique identifier of the user to whom this collection preset applies.

role.description: The unique identifier of a role in the platform. If `user` is null, this will be used to apply the collection preset or bookmark for all users in the role.

collection.description: What collection this collection preset is used for.

layout.description: Key of the layout that is used.

layout_query.description: Layout query that's saved per layout type. Controls what data is fetched on load. These follow the same format as the JS SDK parameters.

layout_options.description: Options of the views. The properties in here are controlled by the layout.

icon.description: Icon displayed in the Admin App for the flow.

color.description: Color of the icon displayed in the Admin App for the flow.

trigger.description: Type of trigger for the flow. One of `hook`, `webhook`, `operation`, `schedule`, `manual`.

accountability.description: The permission used during the flow. One of `$public`, `$trigger`, `$full`, or UUID of a role.

options.description: Options of the selected trigger for the flow.

operation.description: UUID of the operation connected to the trigger in the flow.

date_created.description: Timestamp in ISO8601 when the flow was created.

user_created.description: The user who created the flow.

key.description: Key for the operation. Must be unique within a given flow.

type.description: Type of operation. One of `log`, `mail`, `notification`, `create`, `read`, `request`, `sleep`, `transform`, `trigger`, `condition`, or any type of custom operation extensions.

position_x.description: Position of the operation on the X axis within the flow workspace.

position_y.description: Position of the operation on the Y axis within the flow workspace.

options.description: Options depending on the type of the operation.

resolve.description: The operation triggered when the current operation succeeds (or `then` logic of a condition operation).

reject.description: The operation triggered when the current operation fails (or `otherwise` logic of a condition operation).

date_created.description: Timestamp in ISO8601 when the operation was created.

user_created.description: The user who created the operation.

id.description: Primary key of the Content Version.

key.description: Key of the Content Version, used as the value for the "version" query parameter.

name.description: Descriptive name of the Content Version.

collection.description: Name of the collection the Content Version is created on.

item.description: The item the Content Version is created on.

date_created.description: When the Content Version was created.

date_updated.description: When the Content Version was last updated.

user_created.description: User that created the Content Version.

user_updated.description: User that last updated the Content Version.

delta.description: The current changes compared to the main version of the item.

collection.description: Unique name of the collection this field is in.

field.description: Unique name of the field. Field name is unique within the collection.

bundle.description: Name of the bundle the extension is in.

id.description: Unique identifier for this single collection preset.

collection.description: The collection of the item the Comment is created for.

item.description: The item the Comment is created for.

comment.description: User comment. This will store the comments that show up in the right sidebar of the item edit page in the admin app.

project_color.description: The brand color of the project.

public_note.description: Note rendered on the public pages of the app.

auth_login_attempts.description: Allowed authentication login attempts before the user's status is set to blocked.

storage_asset_transform.description: What transformations are allowed in the assets endpoint.

key.description: Key for the asset. Used in the assets endpoint.

fit.description: Whether to crop the thumbnail to match the size, or maintain the aspect ratio.

arguments.description: A list of arguments to pass to the Sharp method

argument.description: A JSON representation of the argument value

field_comments_settings.description: Specify which collections and fields to enable field comments.

diocese.description: Relevant for canonical paperwork, especially for Christine's PR process where the marriage certificate needs to reference the diocese

recessional_order.description: Recessional order — defaults to reverse processional if not set

attire_override.description: Per-person attire override on top of wedding_roles.attire_description

contact_phone.description: Day-of coordination number — may differ from persons.phone

pair_group.description: Assign the same number to two people who are a couple. Leave empty for unpaired roles.

brief.description: Coordination notes specific to this role

notes.description: Internal coordination notes. Not printed in the mass booklet.

ceiling_amount.description: Maximum amount allocated for this category before contingency.

contingency_percent.description: Percentage buffer on top of ceiling_amount. Defaults to the global contingency set in wedding_settings.

amount_allocated.description: Total value of vendor contracts and bookings assigned to this category.

amount_paid.description: Sum of deposits and payments made to vendors in this category.

is_over_budget.description: Set to true when amount_allocated exceeds ceiling_amount × (1 + contingency_percent / 100). Intended to be updated by a Flow.

notes.description: Internal notes only — not visible to vendors or guests.

name.description: The budget category name. Must be unique.
Display name for this checklist section.

color.description: Accent color for this section in the Directus UI. Purely visual.

slot.description: The liturgical moment this piece is assigned to. Each slot should ideally have one approved piece.

title.description: Title of the piece as it will appear in the mass booklet.

composer.description: Composer or arranger of the piece.

hymnal_reference.description: Reference number from the Catholic Book of Worship or equivalent hymnal. Useful for coordinating with the music director.

approval_status.description: Whether the priest or music director has approved this piece for the Nuptial Mass. A piece should be approved before it appears in the printed booklet.

approval_notes.description: Feedback from the priest or music director on this piece.

notes.description: Internal coordination notes. Not printed in the mass booklet.

date_approved.description: Date and time the approval was given.

label.description: Display name for this moment in the ceremony.

type.description: Category of this ceremony moment. Used for filtering and display.

duration_minutes.description: Estimated duration in minutes. Used to calculate total ceremony length.

notes.description: Internal only. Not printed on any programme.

optional.description: Mark as true for moments that may be skipped depending on the priest's preferences or time constraints.

section_id.description: The checklist section this task belongs to. Deleting the section cascades and removes all its tasks.

description.description: Optional longer description. Good for multi-step tasks or tasks with external references.

status.description: Current progress state of the task.

priority.description: Urgency level. Use "critical" sparingly — for hard deadlines like legal documents or venue deposits.

due_date.description: Deadline for this task. Leave empty for tasks with no fixed date

notes.description: Internal only. Not visible to vendors or guests.

name.description: Business or trading name of the vendor. Used as the display value across all dropdowns that reference vendors.

category.description: Type of service this vendor provides. Drives budget category association and checklist section grouping.

address_line2.description: Suite, unit, floor, or building name (optional)

region.description: Full region name — province, state, or territory

postal_code.description: Postal code, ZIP code, or postcode

subtitle.description: Secondary name shown below the vendor name — e.g. parish, parent organization, or location descriptor

featured.description: Toggle to be featured first in the homepage

requirement.description: Name of the canonical, civil, or sacramental requirement. This is the primary identifier for this record.

description.description: Detailed description of what needs to be done to fulfil this requirement.

due_date.description: Deadline for submitting or completing this requirement. Canonical requirements typically have firm deadlines set by the parish — missing them can delay the wedding date confirmation.

completed_at.description: Date this requirement was fulfilled. Set manually when the document is submitted or the session is attended.

document_file.description: Scanned copy or PDF of the completed document — e.g. baptismal certificate, Pre-Cana completion letter. Store originals safely outside Directus.

issuing_authority.description: The church, diocese, or government body that issues or validates this document. Important for Christine's PR process where marriage certificate provenance matters.

notes.description: Internal coordination notes. Useful for tracking back-and-forth with the parish office.

assigned_to.description: Who is responsible for completing this requirement.

destination.description: Overall destination description for the honeymoon. Used as the display title across the honeymoon planning section.

total_nights.description: Auto-calculated from departure_date and return_date via a Flow. Do not edit manually.

estimated_budget.description: Total honeymoon budget. Should align with the honeymoon ceiling_amount in budget_categories.

notes.description: General honeymoon planning notes.

date_departure.description: Date you leave for the honeymoon. Should be the day after the wedding or later — do not underestimate how exhausted you will be after the wedding.

date_return.description: Date you return home. Used to calculate total_nights.

label.description: What this expense is for. Be specific enough that you remember what it was six months later.

estimated_amount.description: Expected cost before you have an actual figure. Used for planning before quotes come in.

actual_amount.description: Real cost once confirmed. Replaces estimated_amount in budget rollup calculations once set.

notes.description: Any additional context. Especially useful for cash purchases or split payments.

amount.description: Amount of this payment in CAD.

date_deadline.description: Deadline for this payment. Missing a payment deadline can result in vendor cancellation — set this for every payment.

date_paid.description: Date this payment was made. Leave empty until payment is confirmed. A Flow uses this to recalculate contracts.balance_due.

receipt_file.description: Scanned or digital copy of the payment receipt or bank confirmation. Important for dispute resolution.

notes.description: Any additional context about this payment. Useful for tracking e-transfers and bank references.

title.description: Short description of what this contract covers. Useful when a vendor has multiple contracts for different services.

total_value.description: Total agreed contract value. This is the ceiling against which payments are tracked. Update if the contract is amended.

date_signed.description: Date the contract was signed by both parties.

contract_file.description: Date the contract was signed by both parties.

balance_due.description: Remaining balance. Auto-calculated by a Flow as total_value minus the sum of confirmed payments. Do not edit manually.

notes.description: Summary of important contract terms. Not a replacement for reading the actual contract.

name.description: Printed in programme and entourage list

attire_description.description: Standard attire for this role — per-person overrides go on entourage

attire_color.description: Should align with color_primary / color_secondary in wedding_settings

notes.description: Internal coordination only

category.description: The category being adjusted. Leave empty if this is a global budget adjustment affecting overall_budget in wedding_settings.

previous_amount.description: The ceiling_amount or overall_budget value before this adjustment. Record this manually before making the change.

new_amount.description: The ceiling_amount or overall_budget value after this adjustment.

reason.description: Why this adjustment was made. Critical for understanding budget drift when reviewing finances after the wedding.

date_adjusted.description: Date this adjustment was made. Defaults to today.

notes.description: Any additional context around this budget decision.
Stay-specific coordination notes. Separate from the itinerary-level notes on honeymoon_itinerary.

date_check_in.description: Date of check-in. Should match the date of the corresponding itinerary item.

date_check_out.description: Date of check-out. Should match the check_in_date of the next stay or the return_date on the honeymoon singleton.

nights.description: Auto-calculated from check_in_date and check_out_date via a Flow. Do not edit manually.

room_type.description: Room type as it appears on the booking confirmation. Used to verify you received what you booked at check-in.

breakfast_included.description: Set to true if breakfast is included with this stay. Affects meal planning — no need to book a separate breakfast on days this is true.

date.description: Date of this itinerary item. Used to group items by day in the itinerary view.

start_time.description: Planned start time for this item. Used to build the day timeline.

end_time.description: Planned end time for this item. Used to check for scheduling conflicts across the day.

title.description: Display title for this itinerary item. Shown in the itinerary list view regardless of type.

location.description: Location of this itinerary item. Used for building the day-by-day itinerary view.

vendor.description: Vendor or operator for this item — hotel, restaurant, activity provider, rental company. Links to vendors collection.

confirmation_number.description: Booking confirmation number from the vendor or operator.

date_booked.description: Date the booking was made. Leave empty for items that don't require booking.

estimated_cost.description: Expected cost for both of you for this item. Used for honeymoon budget planning against estimated_budget.

estimated_duration.description: Estimated duration in minutes. Useful for activities, transport legs and events to build a realistic day timeline.

notes.description: General notes for this itinerary item. Separate from type-specific notes on the linked record.

status.description: Current planning state of this itinerary item. Update as bookings are confirmed and items are completed.

weather_sensitive.description: Set to true for outdoor items that depend on good weather — hikes, gondola rides, lake activities, scenic drives.

notes.description: Meal-specific coordination notes. Separate from the itinerary-level notes on honeymoon_itinerary.

cuisine.description: Type of cuisine. Useful for planning a varied dining experience across the trip.

dress_code.description: Dress requirement for this restaurant. Some Banff and Canmore fine dining venues enforce this.

meal_type.description: Which meal of the day this is. Drives day structure planning alongside breakfast_included on honeymoon_stays.

notes.description: Transport-specific coordination notes. Good place to note planned stops like Columbia Icefield or Peyto Lake.

from_location.description: Starting point of this transport leg. Should match the location of the previous itinerary item.

to_location.description: Destination of this transport leg. Should match the location of the next itinerary item.

estimated_distance.description: Estimated driving distance in kilometres for this leg. Calgary to Banff is 128km, Banff to Jasper via Icefields Parkway is 288km. Used for fuel and timing planning.

scenic_stops.description: Planned stops along this transport leg. The Icefields Parkway has numerous worthwhile stops — plan extra time if you list several here.

notes.description: Activity-specific coordination notes. Separate from the itinerary-level notes on honeymoon_itinerary.

name.description: Name of the activity. Used as the display value when this record is referenced from honeymoon_itinerary.

difficulty_level.description: Physical difficulty of this activity. Important for planning realistic daily itineraries — do not schedule a hard hike the day after the wedding.

packing_list.description: Packing list specific to this activity. Gear requirements vary significantly between a gondola ride and a glacier hike.

reading.description: The readings row where type is "petitions". Deleting that reading cascades and removes all its petitions.

notes.description: Event-specific coordination notes. Separate from the itinerary-level notes on honeymoon_itinerary.

name.description: Name of the event. Used as the display value when this record is referenced from honeymoon_itinerary.

emcee_script.description: Full emcee script for this item. Used to brief the emcee and as a printed reference on the day.

estimated_start_time.description: Planned start time for this item. Used to build the run-of-show timeline for the emcee and vendors.

av_notes.description: Audio-visual instructions for this item. Shared with the AV vendor or DJ on the day.

notes.description: Internal only. Not printed in the reception programme.

assigned_to.description: Person responsible for or featured in this program item — e.g. the person giving a speech, leading a game, or performing a dance. Links to persons collection.

duration.description: Estimated duration in minutes. Helps calculate whether the full programme fits within reception_end_time.

label.description: Display name of this program item as it will appear in the printed reception programme.

book.description: Name of the scripture book. Leave empty for the Responsorial Psalm if using a refrain-only format.

label.description: Manual free-text name for the reading. Used as the display label in dropdowns and the mass booklet.

approved.description: Must be approved by the parish before going forward with it

announcement_format.description: How the closing announcement directing guests to the reception will be delivered.

announcement_script.description: Exact wording of the closing announcement. Used for both verbal delivery and the printed mass booklet.

location.description: Displayed location on where the wedding is taking place

maintenance.description: Toggle to only reroute to the maintenance  page when website is undergoing changes

number.description: Physical table number on the floor plan. Must be unique across all tables.

name.description: Optional romantic name for this table. Displayed on table cards and the seating chart if used.

capacity.description: Maximum number of guests this table can seat. Used to flag over-capacity assignments. A Flow should compare this against the count of linked guests.

section.description: Area of the venue this table is located in. Useful for large venues with multiple sections.

notes.description: Internal seating coordination notes.

party.description: The table this party is assigned to. Optional — leave empty until seating is finalised. All guests in this party inherit this table assignment through their party relation.

guests.description: Optional override for individual guests within a party who sit at a different table.  Covers edge cases like a large family split across two tables, or a guest with accessibility needs moved to a specific table.

url.description: URL to your registry on that store

uploaded_by_token.description: RSVP token of the uploading party — for attribution

status.description: Only published photos appear in the gallery

message.description: Markdown string — rendered on the guestbook page

name.description: Name as entered by the submitter

status.description: draft = awaiting moderation, published = visible on the guestbook

verified.description: True if name + table number matched a guest record at submission time

guest.description: Linked guest record — set only when verified is true

Collection.description: Collection of which you want to retrieve the items from.
Collection.name: collection

Search.description: Filter by items that contain the given search query in one of their fields.
Search.name: search

Page.description: Cursor for use in pagination. Often used in combination with limit.
Page.name: page

Offset.description: How many items to skip when fetching data.
Offset.name: offset

Sort.description: How to sort the returned items. `sort` is a CSV of fields used to sort the fetched items. Sorting defaults to ascending (ASC) order but a minus sign (` - `) can be used to reverse this to descending (DESC) order. Fields are prioritized by their order in the CSV. You can also use a ` ? ` to sort randomly.
Sort.name: sort

Meta.description: What metadata to return in the response.
Meta.name: meta

Limit.description: A limit on the number of objects that are returned.
Limit.name: limit

Filter.description: Select items in collection by given conditions.
Filter.name: filter

Fields.description: Control what fields are being returned in the object.
Fields.name: fields

Export.name: export
Export.description: Saves the API response to a file. Accepts one of "csv", "csv_utf8", "json", "xml", "yaml".

Version.name: version
Version.description: Retrieve an item's state from a specific Content Version. The value corresponds to the "key" of the Content Version.
